university_building.name: University Building
university_building.description: A large, labyrinthine building filled with classrooms and offices.

classroom.name: Professor Riddle's Classroom
classroom.description: An imposing classroom with old-fashioned furniture and dusty shelves.
classroom.image_prompt: aged magic professor classroom, fantasy art

key2.name: Classroom Key
key2.description: A key that opens the door to Professor Riddle's highly-secured classroom.
key2.image_prompt: magic classroom door key, fantasy style

professor.name: Professor Riddle
professor.description: The same difficult professor from the previous quest, now more frustrated by Alyssa’s persistence.
professor.image_prompt: elderly wizard teacher, old-fashioned clothes, glasses

dialogues.before_talk: Riddle: You must solve this riddle before I grant you access to my classroom!
dialogues.after_talk: Alyssa: Professor, I found a textbook on magic. Do you have any recommendations for further study?
dialogues.after_satisfied: Riddle: Excellent work! Here is the key to your new home.
dialogues.hostile: Riddle: Guards! This student must be punished!

alyssa.name: Alyssa
alyssa.description: The persistent and studious student who wants access to Professor Riddle's classroom.
alyssa.image_prompt: determined student, looking at books with focus in her eyes

dialogues.before_talk: Alyssa: Thank you, professor. I will continue my studies now.
dialogues.after_talk: Alyssa: I have been studying magic for months and found a textbook that looks relevant to your work!
dialogues.after_satisfied: Alyssa: Thank you! I am eager to learn more from your expertise in magic.
dialogues.hostile: Riddle: Not yet, student. You must do better!
